policy.quant_method: per-slice static int8 step, MSE-optimal over the F.2A calibration split
policy.scale_source: testdata/qwen3_f2a_calibration.json (64 cases, sha256 recorded in meta)
policy.partial_gemm_structure: reduction dim partitioned at the finest enabled group; per-partial GEMM_INT8_V1 semantics; weight slice = contiguous K-range slice of the F.1-quantized weight (same step)
policy.requant_common_scale: per-partial REQUANTIZE_V1 to the common Q12.20 scale of the logical sum: mult = step_a*step_w (exact) for accum->fx; mult = round(step_q*step_k*attn_scale/2^20) for scores; ADD_FIXED_V1 saturating across partials
policy.selection_data: testdata/qwen3_f2a_tuning.json (32 cases; search used the first 8)
policy.heldout: testdata/qwen3_f2a_heldout.json (64 cases, untouched at freeze time)
